candidate_retrieval.decision_reason: Top-5 added 5 source hits over Top-3 while adding only two candidates per query.

risk_score.meaning: Similarity/risk score, not plagiarism probability or legal finding.
risk_score.hold_action: Escrow/review hold; never automatic upload rejection by Layer 2 alone.
risk_score.warn_action: Allow registration and display risk score/candidate references.
risk_score.automatic_upload_block: Layer 1 exact fingerprint duplicate match only.

limitations: Positive examples are mainly same-recording synthetic edits, not independent performances or human-arranged covers.
Held-out sample is small; 6 of 119 safe queries crossed HOLD, slightly above the 5% target.
WARN recall on held-out positives was 87.5%, below the 90% target.
A standalone Layer 1 upload API now returns HTTP 409 for exact fingerprint matches. The repository has no existing frontend/backend upload route, so application-level wiring is still required.
